paper.title: A Deep Neural Framework for Continuous Sign Language Recognition by Iterative Training Survey

description: A narrative survey of sensor and camera-based gesture-recognition methods, with discussion of gloves, image processing and neural networks.
reason: The full text does not meet M2’s project-specific threshold: its ten survey sections do not compare two identifiable CSLR studies. Cui’s continuous-recognition paper appears only in the references.

M1.reason: The literature survey is the main body; it is not merely background to an evaluated new method.

M2.reason: Ten numbered survey sections cover mostly gestures/alphabet recognition; no section/table/sustained discussion compares two distinct CSLR studies.

M3.reason: Image-based and webcam methods are discussed.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.1–4 (printed pp.620–623), Literature Survey sections 1–10, Conclusion and References
evidence.passage: The body reviews sensor gloves, static palm images, PCA posture matching, multimodal sensors and neural gesture classifiers; Cui et al.2019 occurs as reference [1] without discussion. No comparative CSLR section or table is present.

assessments.reason: Abstract proposes a recognition system but survey title suggests synthesis; full text needed to distinguish purpose and coverage.

assessment_metadata.lead_review: Evidence and criterion application checked before integration; AI proposal only.
